content: GNU sed manual: in the C locale sed processes each octet separately. Reproduced on dev host 2026-09-28: the skill's label expression sed 's/-/ /g; s/\b\(.\)/\u\1/g' turns 'autenticacao' into corrupt bytes under LC_ALL=C ('Autentica<mangled>~O') but yields correct 'Autenticacao' under a UTF-8 locale; under UTF-8 it still produces English Title Case of every word, which is wrong PT-BR heading style (sentence case expected). Derived from filenames, labels must not be title-cased or byte-mangled for pt-br output.
